name: tortuna-range-field-2026
why: The model carried only the visibly grassed southern wedge of the range (tortuna-range-grassed-front, 4,680 m², drawn 2026-09-09 with "no full-range mowing boundary claim"), so the landing field between it and the ball-stop net rendered as rough and the net stood in rough 100 m beyond the mown ground. The owner states (2026-09-10) that the driving range is grass; the whole field the net closes is the range.

properties.method: boundary read by eye off a labelled 0.25 m crop of the 2026-05-02 orthophoto (Min karta WMS) along the edges it shows: the tee line (the retained grassed-front ring's own south-west edge; the mats and their access strip stay outside), the barn and the machinery yard (excluded), the field's northern edge under the tree line, the ball-stop net (its ten measured posts from apps/golf/src/engine/scenery/tortuna-range-site.json, verbatim), and the south-east edge against the ditch and hedge along the ploughed field (the traced earthworks' own south-east edge)
properties.materialStatus: grass by the owner's statement of 2026-09-10; the May 2026 capture shows most of the landing field as bare fill the club was still grassing (its 2025 report), which dates the capture, not the surface
roleEvidence: caddee-overview (DRIVING RANGE is drawn on this field)
properties.uncertaintyStatus: interpretation allowance, not measured positional accuracy
properties.earthworksRelation: 94% of the scraped extent traced in apps/golf/src/engine/scenery/tortuna-range-site.json (earthworks, 9,606 m², a reading that is never drawn) lies inside this field. The rest is the edge within the interpretation allowance and a scraped working strip north of the field edge beside the machinery yard, about 300 m², which is left out of the range.
